data.name: Musaddid
data.gender_notes: Musaddid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who adds, completes, or perfects. The name Musaddid carries the meaning “Addition, Improvement” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Musaddid usually hope their child will grow to embody addition, improvement and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who enriches and enhances the spiritual journey of others
data.etymology: Musaddid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Addition, Improvement.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musaddid total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مُصَدِّد
in_arabic.meaning: ذو القدرة على إعادة الماضي إلى حقيقته
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل المُصَدِّد من المصاد، والصاد في اللغة العربية يُراد به العودة والرجوع، وقد أريد به أيضاً إعادة الماضي إلى حقيقته، ومنه قول الله تعالى: ((وَلَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَرَضُوا عَنِهِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ))، فالمُصَدِّد هو من يُعاد للقديم من الزمن، ويُعاد أيضاً للصواب من الخطأ

in_urdu.name: مصدّد
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو ماضی کو اپنی حقیقت میں لوٹا دیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی میں مصدّد کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو ماضی کو اپنی حقیقت میں لوٹا دیتا ہے، اس کے معنی ہیں وہ شخص جو ماضی کے گزرے ہوئے وقتوں کو دوبارہ حاضر کرتا ہے، اور جس کے ذریعہ ماضی کی حقیقت کا علم ہوتا ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: ((وَلَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَرَضُوا عَنِهِ)) فمصدّد وہ شخص ہے جو ماضی کو اس کی حقیقت میں لوٹاتا ہے

in_english.name: Musaddid
in_english.meaning: The person who brings the past back to its reality and truth
in_english.long_meaning: The word Musaddid is derived from the Arabic root 'Sad-Daal', which means to return or come back to something. In Islamic tradition, Musaddid refers to a person who brings the past back to its reality and truth, and who has the ability to recall and remember past events and experiences. This person is often associated with the attribute of being mindful and aware of the past, and is seen as a reminder of the importance of learning from history and past experiences. In Arabic, the word Musaddid is often used to describe a person who is knowledgeable about the past and has a deep understanding of history. In Islamic spirituality, Musaddid is also associated with the concept of 'tafsir', or interpretation and understanding of the Quran.

This name signifies a person who adds to the existing knowledge or completes a body of work. The term is often used to describe scholars or authors who have made a substantial contribution to a particular field or genre. data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Musaddid" holds great significance in Islam as it implies the concept of "Tawhid," or the oneness of Allah. A Musaddid, in the eyes of Allah, is one who strives to complete the spiritual journey of his or her life by continuously seeking knowledge and understanding of Allah's creation. This can be achieved by reading the Quran, following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW), and striving towards moral, ethical, and social excellence. Furthermore, a person who also adds to the spiritual growth of others by teaching, guiding, and inspiring them, is truly living the meaning of the name Musaddid.
